note: Inputs of duan_scft_check.py. digitized: pixel readings of Figs. 2-3 of the paper, not author data. scan: archived L = 200 nm SCFT scan. extended_box: SCFT with a flat far region; warm_run is the archived run that started it. layer: stored output of the layer command. grounded_box: SCFT in a real box of length L with psi(L) = 0. box_scan: SCFT stepped through box lengths, direction up or down. background_scan: fixed 1:1 background c1 in M instead of canonical C. common_box: direct solutions at L = 6500 nm with graft widths 0.5 and 0.125 nm. experiment_solution: z = 3 at the solutions of Yu et al. 2016 (NaNO3 + Y(NO3)3 at ionic strength 6 mM); figure7 is read by eye from their Fig. 7, about +/-0.02. figure7: multivalent symbols of Fig. 2 of the paper, read by eye from Fig. 7 of Yu et al. 2016, about +/-0.02. ionic_series: z = 3 at ionic strength 6 mM, 1:1 background c1 = 0.006 - 6 rho, height 2<z> and outer edge of the model phi at 0.03, 0.05, 0.09; series reference (N = 100, 1:1 salt only; N = 730, rho = 1e-10), n100 (dz 0.125, box 200 nm), ladder (fixed rho, chain raised in 5 % steps, dz 0.25, box max(200, 1.1 N)), walk730 (N = 730, rho raised, box 800 nm, dz 0.25), onset_up and onset_down (fixed N, rho in 2 % steps). plus_excess is Y per nm^2, dense the thickness with phi > 0.4. ionic_profiles: phi against z/N.

digitized.method: Color-separated pixel groups in +/-3 pixel windows. Fig. 2 groups selected using recorded image-only pixel guides; experimental symbols excluded.
digitized.limitation: Selected interior raster points; uncertainties are approximate reading ranges, not statistical errors or author data.
